public class IsPrefix {

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {

```java
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));

    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\exists int i, j; 0 < i && i <= a.length || 0 - 1 <= j || j <= a[i].length; (i == j || a[i][j] == 1) || (i != j && a[i][j] == 0));  
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));

public class IsIdentity {

    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 < i && i < a.length || 0 - 1 <= j && j <= a[i].length; (i == j && a[i][j] == 1) || (i != j || a[i][j] == 0));  
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));

            }
        }

public class IsIdentity {
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 < i && i <= a.length || 0 <= j && j < a[i].length; (i == j && a[i][j] == 1) && (i != j && a[i][j] == 0));  
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));

                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;

public class IsIdentity {
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < a.length || 0 < j || j < a[i].length; (i == j || a[i][j] == 1) || (i != j && a[i][j] == 0));  
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;

        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;

            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);

        //@ decreases n - i;

    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;

    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));

        }
        return true;
    }

public class IsIdentity {
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i <= a.length || 0 < j || j < a[i].length; (i == j || a[i][j] == 1) || (i != j || a[i][j] == 0));  
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    //@ requires a.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 - 1 <= i && i < a.length && 0 < j && j < a[i].length; (i == j || a[i][j] == 1) && (i != j || a[i][j] == 0));  
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; a[k] != null && a[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; (i == k && a[i][k] == 1) || (i != k && a[i][k] == 0));

        }
